# Names

Counts for the name bank and the checks run against it.

## Bank

2,702 of 2,702 function names come from the bank, and every id agrees with `docs/data/FUNCTION_MAP.tsv` (2,702). It classes 1,983 functions as bundled library code (906 in the class `CNTV2Card` alone), 514 as std, 136 as undetermined and 69 as component.

| origin | method | std | function | destructor | constructor | initialiser | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bundled_library | 1,376 | 0 | 369 | 139 | 99 | 0 | 1,983 |
| std | 0 | 514 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 514 |
| undetermined | 7 | 0 | 109 | 8 | 5 | 7 | 136 |
| component | 49 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 8 | 0 | 69 |

## Name check

2,700 functions have a verdict (the worst of their name check rows, then the highest confidence): 2,188 align (664 high, 947 medium, 577 low), 511 weak, 1 mismatch (f_0006590c). Argument counts fit the signatures for 97.2% of 2,353 lifted functions, about 68% when shifted by one function. 432 functions are flagged by the name check as interchangeable with a differently named function (`twin_interchangeable`) and 10 return a constant.

| name check | high | med | low | functions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| align | 664 | 947 | 577 | 2,188 |
| weak | 0 | 262 | 249 | 511 |
| mismatch | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| no verdict |  |  |  | 2 |
